summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-10-14 ~ 2026-10-16）

- 🔥 Arm64 引入 CLA 核心本地加速器驱动及 KVM 侧 VMID/MMU 配套，降低共享数据访存延迟（[Virtualization](#subsystem-Virtualization)）
- ✨ 新增通用 attestation 子系统并接入 TDX 证明流程，统一 ABI 与规格文档（[Virtualization](#subsystem-Virtualization)）
- 🛡 vsprintf/kallsyms 不再输出未哈希的指针，避免向受限用户泄露内核地址（[Core Kernel](#subsystem-Core%20Kernel)）
- 🐛 回滚 enqueue_task_fair 的死代码清理，恢复被误删逻辑以免公平调度入队异常（[Scheduling](#subsystem-Scheduling)）
- ⚡ vfs 新增 super_iter_inodes 迭代接口，取代遍历 inode 链表以降低 drop_caches 开销（[Filesystem & Storage](#subsystem-Filesystem%20%26%20Storage)）
- ✨ tick/nohz 新增非空闲 tick 关闭的运行时开关，经 sysfs 与 trace 事件对外暴露（[Clocks & Timers](#subsystem-Clocks%20%26%20Timers)）

## Drivers
- `perf` `bugfix` serial: amba-pl011 修复 RS485 使能与恢复时方向状态残留，避免收发配置错乱 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/659)
- `perf` `bugfix` i2c-mux 支持每通道独立总线速率，避免复用后所有通道被迫降到最低速率 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1342)
- `perf` iio: ad7606 改用 EXPORT_NS_GPL_SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS 与命名空间变量，精简电源管理回调 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2352)
- `perf` serial: imx 在 RS485 发送期间阻止 CPU 进入深度空闲，降低发送延迟与丢字节风险 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2042)
- `perf` `other` soc: qcom geni 由各子系统推导 SE 时钟配置，去掉硬编码频率以提升 SPI/I2C/串口速率 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1675)
- `bugfix` fbcon 修复旋转字体在字体切换时的缓冲区处理，避免显示错乱与越界 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/629)
- `bugfix` ASoC 四款 codec 修正指向错误寄存器的控制定义，避免调音误操作他路 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/608)
- `bugfix` ASoC: q6afe 修复时钟投票响应处理，防止 AFE 端口时钟状态不一致 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/513)
- `bugfix` drm/panic 修复超长日志行导致 kmsg 屏幕卡死，恢复 panic 输出可用性 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3206)
- `bugfix` fbcon 修正旋转字体缓冲区的释放与重分配流程，防止字体切换后花屏 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/319)
- 另有 83 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3166) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3153) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3149) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3143) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3141) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2591) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2422) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2104) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2194) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1948) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1557) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1554) 等 83 项

## Networking
- `perf` `bugfix` ath10k WCN3990 修复 PMF 与省电相关站点问题，改善连接稳定性与吞吐。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/76)
- `perf` `bugfix` lan743x 增加 TX 超时自动恢复流程，减少发送挂死造成的链路中断。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2103)
- `perf` `bugfix` sfc 修复 PTP 同步竞争，提升时间戳精度与同步可靠性。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1437)
- `perf` `bugfix` realtek PHY 恢复 RTL8211F 的 RGMII 延迟设置，修正链路时序。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/397)
- `perf` rtl8365mb 新增 VLAN 支持，扩展 Realtek DSA 交换芯片的 VLAN 处理能力。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/113)
- `perf` 新增 motorcomm 四口 2.5G PHY 驱动，补全 C45 与 MDIO 支持。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2049)
- `perf` ceph 支持子卷隔离（quarantine），扩展分布式文件系统运维能力。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2470)
- `perf` `other` net: 避免 defer_count 在 defer_list 为空后仍残留，修正延迟回收计数。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2532)
- `bugfix` ipconfig 修复 DHCP 选项解析中的越界读取，避免解析畸形包时内存访问越界。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/352)
- `bugfix` cls_flow 修复 perturb 周期计算中的整数溢出，防止流分类哈希异常。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/336)
- 另有 78 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/350) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/365) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/301) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/468) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3123) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3117) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/68) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2951) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2939) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2444) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2392) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2380) 等 78 项

## Filesystem & Storage
- `perf` `bugfix` btrfs：7.4 更新合集，覆盖 bio、压缩、空间管理等大量修复与性能改动。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2614)
- `perf` `bugfix` jffs2：空 summary 时禁用 summary 而非调用 BUG，避免可恢复场景直接崩溃。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2336)
- `perf` `bugfix` ext4：unwritten extent 转换失败按写错误上报，让上层感知数据丢失风险。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1236)
- `perf` kernfs：在 kernfs_rwsem 之外分配 inode，缩短持锁时间、提升并发创建性能。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2964)
- `perf` async_tx：RFC 移除 async_tx 框架，改由 md/RAID 自带实现，减少冗余代码路径。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2649)
- `perf` ibmvfc：支持 FPIN 消息上报链路错误，便于光纤通道故障定位。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2241)
- `perf` vfs：新增 super_iter_inodes 迭代接口，替代遍历 inode 链表，降低 drop_caches 等开销。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1056)
- `perf` `other` blk-mq：hctx 无 housekeeping CPU 时把 dispatch kworker 派到 housekeeping CPU，减少调度干扰。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/428)
- `perf` `other` zram：重构 zcomp 抽象并重写各压缩后端，精简接口、降低内存与调用开销。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/393)
- `perf` `other` pipe：新页拷贝按迭代器剩余字节数限幅，避免多余拷贝开销。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/903)
- 另有 72 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/571) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/454) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/449) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/443) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/363) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/362) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/348) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/312) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/198) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3125) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2569) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2555) 等 72 项

## Architecture
- `perf` `bugfix` kdump 缩减 vmcore 尺寸与捕获时间，跨 x86/arm64/riscv/loongarch 与 of、memblock 路径。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/499)
- `perf` `bugfix` kdump 补丁 v8 重发，减少 vmcore 体积并缩短崩溃转储捕获耗时。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/257)
- `perf` `bugfix` amd/ibs 多项修复，校正 IBS 采样与中断处理中的计数问题。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/486)
- `perf` sm8350 dts 增加 L3 与内存带宽缩放节点，配合 interconnect 按负载调频。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/465)
- `perf` x86 限制分支快照只取有效项，AMD/Intel LBR 不再记录越界条目。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1450)
- `perf` 将 SA8255P 引入 Lemans 家族 dts，新增 ride 等板级配置以复用平台代码。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/277)
- `perf` `other` riscv mm 让 GUP-fast 不再跟随缺少 _PAGE 标记的表项，避免错误 pin 页。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3140)
- `perf` `other` ehci-pci 为 Intel CE5300 上的 TDI EHCI 设置 has_hostpc，修正端口能力判断。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3098)
- `bugfix` usbtest simple_io 在参数为零时防除零，避免 USB 测试模块崩溃。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/627)
- `bugfix` glymur 修正 fastrpc compute-cb 内存区域，同步 DT 绑定避免地址冲突。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/514)
- 另有 66 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/349) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/238) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/223) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/57) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2901) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2834) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2346) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1264) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1149) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/876) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/835) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/755) 等 66 项

## Observability
- `perf` `bugfix` ：bpf 修复 __bpf_get_stackid 中 stackmap 溢出检查，避免越界或错误返回。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3135)
- `perf` `bugfix` ：perf c2c 修复输出字段内存泄漏，减少长时间运行内存占用。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3025)
- `perf` perf test attr 重新报告失败并适配缺失特性，增强测试健壮性。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3071)
- `perf` perf 将 SPE 与 TRBE 的 padding 提前到发布 AUX 数据之前，保证数据一致性。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2296)
- `perf` perf arm_spe 支持异构 ACPI 系统，扩展 SPE 在不同 CPU 上的可用性。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/516)
- `perf` `other` ：perf ftrace 支持内联函数解析，补充测试与文档，便于观察内联调用路径。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/329)
- `perf` `other` ：tracing/syscalls 对可缺页系统调用改用 copy_from_user，提升 faultable syscall 访问安全性。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/299)
- `perf` `other` ：blk-iocost 将 hweights 作为单个原子值发布，避免监控端读到撕裂数据。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1875)
- `bugfix` ：tracing 在更新模块时持有 trace_types_lock，避免并发修改导致链表竞态。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/486)
- `bugfix` ：tracing 在 per-module 更新中加锁 trace_types_lock，消除竞态访问。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/442)
- 另有 25 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/232) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3134) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3128) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/174) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/88) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3156) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1786) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1741) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1414) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/729) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/167) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/619) 等 25 项

## Core Kernel
- `perf` `bugfix` core：修复 owner-list 发布与 remove-on-exec 的竞态，防止释放后使用。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1592)
- `perf` 新增 smp_cond_load_relaxed/acquire_timeout 屏障原语，缩减忙等场景的延迟探测开销。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/574)
- `perf` 让 KCSAN 支持 Rust 构建，可对 Rust 代码开启数据竞争检测。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2105)
- `perf` `other` lib/stackdepot 删除 stack_depot 中逻辑上不可达的死代码，减少冗余分支。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3209)
- `perf` `other` core：exec 已移除事件后不再发送 SIGTRAP，避免进程收到虚假信号。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2158)
- `perf` `other` core：多路复用事件轮转时同步更新 cgroup 时间，修正统计偏差。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1665)
- `bugfix` vsprintf/kallsyms 停止输出未哈希指针，避免向受限用户泄露内核地址。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2340)
- `bugfix` 修复 RCU 模式 maple tree 释放路径的两处缺陷，避免节点泄漏与崩溃。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2137)
- `bugfix` sparc32：修复 SMP 与 futex 支持并新增 cmpxchg 系统调用，使多核真正可用。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/898)
- 将 unroll.h 的 unrolled/unrolled_full/unrolled_none 改为函数并修正 blake2 调用。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/230)
- 另有 7 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1762) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1081) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/334) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/217) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1871) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/508) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/494)

## Memory
- `perf` mm/vmscan 在内存隔离场景下对 MGLRU 回收施加节流，降低隔离期间的回收抖动 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/721)
- `perf` `other` writeback 允许外来刷写触及正在销毁的 cgwb，避免刷写线程长期阻塞在 dying cgroup 上 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1436)
- `bugfix` khugepaged 修复 collapse 路径中预读与锁的逆序加锁，消除潜在死锁 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/554)
- `bugfix` mm/memory 修复截断路径误移除已映射 folio，避免页表残留指向已释放页 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/172)
- `bugfix` mm/mempolicy 将 mempolicy 引用计数改用 refcount_t，防止溢出与 UAF [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3016)
- `bugfix` mm/page_alloc 校验 zonelist 槽位以应对并发修改，避免越界访问 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2875)
- `bugfix` mm/vma 修复 mm_lock_seq 溢出导致的虚假写锁，减少无谓的写锁获取 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2826)
- `bugfix` mm/oom_kill 修复 oom_evaluate_task 中的竞态，避免评分结果被并发篡改 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2609)
- `bugfix` mm 系列修复共 10 个：涉及 hugetlb、mremap、vma，修正映射与重映射中的边界处理 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2285)
- `bugfix` mm 修复 VMA 代号复用导致读者被跳过的问题，保证序列号变更可见 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1970)
- 另有 5 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/493) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1034) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/3102) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2180) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1933)

## Scheduling
- `perf` x86/sched/mm 系列提速大机型 CPU 热插拔，缩短下线等待与 trampoline 同步开销 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2159)
- `perf` `other` sched/cache 不再发布未完成的 LLC 利用率快照，避免下游读到部分更新的分组容量数据 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/286)
- `bugfix` sched/uclamp 在 task_rq_lock 下校验 min/max 配对，防止并发写入产生非法 uclamp 区间 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/16/508)
- `bugfix` sched_ext 修复调度器销毁路径上的 use-after-free，避免释放后仍访问已注销对象 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/2398)
- `bugfix` sched/idle 让强制轮询状态切换具备竞态安全性，消除并发设置导致的空闲状态错乱 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/1069)
- `bugfix` 回滚 enqueue_task_fair 的死代码清理，恢复被误删逻辑以免公平调度入队行为异常 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/840)
- `bugfix` sched/idle 在 play_idle_precise 中销毁栈上 hrtimer，防止定时器残留引发后续访问 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/15/287)
